In The High Court Of Himachal Pradesh At Shimla Cr.MMO No. 352 of 2018 Date of Decision 8th July, 2019 _________________________________________________________________ M/s Pernod Ricard India Pvt.Ltd. ...Petitioner Versus State of H.P. and others Coram r to .... texts.facts: 2 Prosecution, against the petitioner as well as respondents No. 2 and 3, has been launched under Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 for not mentioning the details 'best before date' on whisky bottle containing more than 10% alcoholic strength as it was treated as misbranding of product.
